violated_contract: A deterministic sync upload refusal without a user repair must preserve audio and produce bounded operator feedback without repeated user Retry prompts or an unbounded pending-work time span.
canonical_prevention: Persist closed refusal reasons and a daily recovery clock separately from transient retry budgets. Keep refused audio outside user attention, expose an aggregate, accept no-audio clips as no-ops, and derive pending spans from current work with authoritative job reconciliation.
